risks.risk: No lens shown: price could be for body only, and missing lens reduces value vs kit listings.
risks.proof: Ask for a photo of the full package showing whether a lens is included (front + mount + lens model label if any).
risks.if_unproven: Price as body only (worst case vs any kit).

risks.risk: Unclear shutter count / wear: photos don’t show shutter count or sensor condition.
risks.proof: Ask for a screen capture of shutter count (or camera menu page showing it) and a close photo of the sensor at high magnification (or a test shot of a blank wall).
risks.if_unproven: Price as used with unknown wear (worst case).

risks.risk: Functionality not proven: camera screen is on, but autofocus, buttons, ports, and image quality are not verified.
risks.proof: Ask for a short video clip showing: autofocus on a subject, taking a photo, and reviewing the image on the LCD.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully verified (worst case).

risks.risk: Accessories may be missing or not genuine: batteries/charger/trigger are claimed but not shown.
risks.proof: Ask for photos of both batteries (labels), the charger model, and the Godox mini trigger with its model visible.
risks.if_unproven: Price as camera body only (worst case: accessories not included).

risks.risk: Potential mismatch: '5D Mark III' is visible, but the exact variant and completeness (body only vs kit) is not fully confirmed.
risks.proof: Ask for a photo of the camera’s bottom plate/model label and the box contents list.
risks.if_unproven: Price as Canon 5D Mark III body only.

proof_requests: Photo of the full items included: both batteries, charger, and the Godox mini trigger (with model labels visible).
Confirm whether a lens is included: photo of the camera with the lens mounted and a close-up of the lens model label.
Video clip: autofocus + take a photo + playback on the LCD.
Screen capture/photo of shutter count (or equivalent) and a sensor test shot (blank wall at f/8).
response.reason: The photos clearly show a Canon 5D Mark III body (Mark III text visible). However, accessories and lens inclusion are not shown, so the safest valuation is worst-case as body-only with unverified accessories.
